evidence.title: Daniel Suárez
evidence.text: Daniel Alejandro Suárez Garza (born January 7, 1992) is a Mexican professional stock car racing driver.

evidence.title: Daniel Suárez
evidence.text: He currently competes full-time in the Monster Energy NASCAR Cup Series, driving the No. 19 Toyota Camry for Joe Gibbs Racing, and part-time in the Xfinity Series, driving the No. 18 and No. 20 Camrys for JGR.

evidence.title: Daniel Suárez
evidence.text: Previously he drove in the NASCAR Toyota Series in Mexico for Telcel Racing, and the K&N Pro Series East for Rev Racing as a member of the Drive for Diversity program.

evidence.title: Daniel Suárez
evidence.text: He is the 2016 NASCAR Xfinity Series champion.

evidence.title: 2013 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: The 2013 Bojangles' Southern 500, the 64th running of the event, was a NASCAR Sprint Cup Series stock car race held on May 11, 2013, at Darlington Raceway in Darlington, South Carolina, United States.

evidence.title: 2013 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: The race was contested over 367 laps on the 1.366–mile (2.198 km) oval, it was the eleventh race of the 2013 Sprint Cup Series championship.

evidence.title: 2013 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: Matt Kenseth of Joe Gibbs Racing won the race, his third win of the 2013 season, while his teammate Denny Hamlin finished second.

evidence.title: 2013 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: Jeff Gordon grabbed his 300th top 5 finish in his 700th Sprint Cup start, while Jimmie Johnson and Kevin Harvick rounded out the top five.

evidence.title: O'Reilly Auto Parts 300 (fall race)
evidence.text: The O'Reilly Auto Parts 300 is a NASCAR Xfinity Series stock car race that takes place at Texas Motor Speedway in Fort Worth, Texas.

evidence.title: O'Reilly Auto Parts 300 (fall race)
evidence.text: The race came about from the results of the Ferko lawsuit in 2004.

evidence.title: O'Reilly Auto Parts 300 (fall race)
evidence.text: With Darlington Raceway forced to forfeit its Southern 500 weekend as a result of the lawsuit, TMS gained a second weekend on the schedule for the Monster Energy NASCAR Cup Series and Xfinity Series racing, and fifth race for the NASCAR Xfinity Series playoffs.

evidence.title: 2016 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: The 2016 Bojangles' Southern 500, the 67th running of the event, was a NASCAR Sprint Cup Series stock car race that was held on September 4, 2016 at Darlington Raceway in Darlington, South Carolina.

evidence.title: 2016 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: Contested over 367 laps on the 1.366 mi egg-shaped oval, it was the 25th race of the 2016 NASCAR Sprint Cup Series season.

evidence.title: 2016 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: Furniture Row Racing's Martin Truex Jr. won the race by holding off Kevin Harvick to earn his second victory of the 2016 season.

evidence.title: 2014 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: The 2014 Bojangles' Southern 500, the 58th running of the event that traces its lineage to the 1957 Rebel 300, was a NASCAR Sprint Cup Series stock car race held on April 12, 2014, at Darlington Raceway in Darlington, South Carolina.

evidence.title: 2014 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: The race was contested over 374 laps – extended from 367 laps due to two attempts at a green–white–checker finish – on the 1.366 mi oval, it was the eighth race of the 2014 NASCAR Sprint Cup Series.

evidence.title: 2014 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: Kevin Harvick of Stewart-Haas Racing won the race, his second win of the season and first at Darlington, while Dale Earnhardt, Jr. finished second.

evidence.title: 2014 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: Jimmie Johnson, Matt Kenseth, and Greg Biffle rounded out the top five.

evidence.title: 2014 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: The race was also the first Darlington race won by a polesitter since Dale Jarrett, in the 1997 Rebel (then a 400-mile race).

evidence.title: 2014 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: The top rookies of the race were Kyle Larson (8th), Austin Dillon (11th), and Justin Allgaier (23rd).

evidence.title: 2014 Bojangles' Southern 500
evidence.text: It was the longest race in Darlington Raceway history.
